entries.source: Sofa Ride in Alanya. Fast sofa-style inflatable water ride for 2–6 guests. 10–12 minutes of speed, splashes and adrenaline on the Mediterranean Sea. Minimum 2 people from €140.
entries.translation: Sofa Ride in Alanya. Fast sofa-style inflatable water ride for 2–6 guests. 10–12 minutes of speed, splashes and adrenaline on the Mediterranean Sea. Minimum 2 people from €140.

entries.source: Fast sofa-style inflatable ride full of speed, splashes and adrenaline
entries.translation: Fast sofa-style inflatable ride full of speed, splashes and adrenaline

entries.source: Enjoy an exciting Sofa Ride in Alanya with friends and family. Lie down, hold tight, feel the speed and enjoy 10–12 minutes of splashes, laughter and Mediterranean adrenaline.
entries.translation: Enjoy an exciting Sofa Ride in Alanya with friends and family. Lie down, hold tight, feel the speed and enjoy 10–12 minutes of splashes, laughter and Mediterranean adrenaline.

entries.source: Sofa Ride is a private towable-water attraction for groups of two to six participants.
entries.translation: Sofa Ride is a private towable-water attraction for groups of two to six participants.

entries.source: The inflatable sofa is pulled by a motorboat while guests lie in the designated riding position, hold the safety handles and follow the crew’s signals.
entries.translation: The inflatable sofa is pulled by a motorboat while guests lie in the designated riding position, hold the safety handles and follow the crew’s signals.

entries.source: No previous experience is normally required. Before departure, the team explains body position, grip, safe behavior during turns and what to do if a participant falls into the water.
entries.translation: No previous experience is normally required. Before departure, the team explains body position, grip, safe behavior during turns and what to do if a participant falls into the water.

entries.source: The booked ride lasts approximately 10–12 minutes. Speed and intensity are selected by the boat crew according to the group, sea conditions and safety requirements.
entries.translation: The booked ride lasts approximately 10–12 minutes. Speed and intensity are selected by the boat crew according to the group, sea conditions and safety requirements.

entries.source: The ride is arranged for your own group of two to six guests.
entries.translation: The ride is arranged for your own group of two to six guests.

entries.source: Feel acceleration, waves and water spray behind the motorboat.
entries.translation: Feel acceleration, waves and water spray behind the motorboat.

entries.source: The crew stops or adjusts the activity and follows its recovery procedure. Participants must remain calm and follow the signals explained during the briefing.

entries.source: The activity may be delayed, shortened, rescheduled or cancelled when wind, waves or visibility do not allow safe operation.
